svg.title: SSG-SAK Tech Stack
svg.desc: Data and Analytics: Python, SQL, pandas, NumPy, GeoPandas, scikit-learn, Jupyter, matplotlib, seaborn. Frontend: React, TypeScript. Backend: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy. Database: SQLite. Testing and DevOps: pytest, Playwright, Git, GitHub Actions, Render, GitHub Pages. Currently Learning: PostgreSQL and Power BI.
